title: The fingerprint misses GitLab.com's stream marker on a continuation line (01O+ with no space)
goal: LOG_PREFIX_RE strips a stream marker with a + continuation whether or not a space follows it, so a test id or error line on a continuation line gives the same fingerprint as on a first line; the test fixture uses the real 00O+ form with no space.

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import backlog as b; assert b.first_failure('2026-09-29T01:06:40.9Z 01O+FAILED a.py::t - x')=='a.py::t'
